messages.subject: get() Plot Properties
parts:
Hello all,

I'm writing an app that displays a phylogeny that the user can interact with.
The phylogeny is plotted and then the user can click on the plot where they would like to zoom on.
So, I'm trying to use the clickId of the plotOutput function, which works fine.
Then I would compare this to the location of different aspects of the phylogeny.
However, what I'm having trouble doing is getting the properties of the plotted phylogeny.
In other similar R functions, the properties of the phylogeny (where the lines intersect, etc.) can be retrieved using get("last_plot.phylo", envir = .PlotPhyloEnv).
I tried using this get function both outside and inside of the renderPlot function, neither of which is able to actually get the properties.
Once a plot is made, is there any way to get these properties like one would in a normal R session?
Any thoughts?

Thanks,
Will
